evidence.method: one-off live Playwright desktop/mobile observation with SHA-addressed internal screenshots

notes.structure: Long single-page studio narrative: oversized mixed-type hero, capability overview, editorial portfolio sequence, recent-work grid, and contact/footer close.
notes.desktop: Wide editorial grid with large left-aligned statements, offset media blocks, deliberate whitespace, and persistent horizontal navigation.
notes.mobile: Single-column reflow preserves the mixed-type headline and layered hero while collapsing navigation to a compact menu control.
notes.runtime_observation: Desktop measured 7714px across a 900px viewport; mobile measured 8380px across an 844px viewport.

notes.roles: Bold grotesk establishes navigation, labels and emphatic headline fragments; a high-contrast serif supplies editorial counter-rhythm and long-form statements.
notes.composition: Type behaves as image and structure: mixed faces share lines, scale shifts define pacing, and circular annotation marks add a hand-directed layer.
notes.copying_boundary: V0 may reproduce role contrast and rhythm only; Wanaka font files and exact copy are prohibited.

evidence.method: computed font families plus visual inspection

notes.logic: A near-monochrome editorial shell lets work imagery and one saturated hero accent carry emphasis.

evidence.method: computed color sample and visual inspection

notes.observed_affordances: The runtime exposed 70 transformed and 81 animated/transitioned visible elements on desktop, with one canvas and fixed/sticky navigation elements.
notes.interaction_evidence: A project hover reveals a large circular cursor/arrow overlay on the media card; still captures prove states, not animation timing or easing.
notes.choreography: Large whitespace and alternating statement/media positions create scroll-paced reveals; important motion quality remains a visual-sequence question.

evidence.method: runtime computed-state counts plus ordered still-state comparison

inferred.claim: The canvas likely contributes to decorative or interactive hero behavior.
inferred.basis: One canvas is present, but no hidden source inspection or decompilation was performed.

notes.limitation: No performance score is inferred from one observation.

notes.positive: Semantic headings and links are present; mobile exposes a text menu control.
notes.unverified: Keyboard order, focus states, accessible canvas alternatives, contrast and screen-reader output require separate checks.

evidence.method: DOM inventory and static visual inspection

principles.rule: Treat typography as the primary composition system by pairing emphatic grotesk fragments with editorial serif counter-rhythm.
Use generous paper-like whitespace and offset media to pace a long portfolio narrative instead of filling a uniform card grid.
Preserve the visual concept on mobile through deliberate re-composition rather than simple proportional shrinking.
Make interactive affordance visible at the media surface; the project-hover cursor links action and content.
Keep the shell restrained so project imagery and one saturated accent can provide local emphasis.

inferences: The award-quality effect depends on coordinated typography, spacing, media cropping and interaction states rather than any one component.
V0 must test responsive re-composition and scroll pacing, not merely reproduce the desktop hero.
Static screenshots cannot establish animation timing, easing or transition continuity; those remain explicit limitations.

anti_patterns.issue: Copying Wanaka branding, artwork, text, fonts, source code or exact section geometry would violate the observe-only boundary.
Treating transformed-element counts or still frames as proof of motion quality would overstate the evidence.
